description: Checkout, licensing and settlement API for software — one integration reaches Zimbabwean wallets (EcoCash, OneMoney, InnBucks, Telecash, O'mari, ZimSwitch) and international rails (Visa, Mastercard, PayPal). Merchants self-register with one POST.

authentication.note: none for wavepay_register; x-wavepay-service-key: mk_live_… (or mk_test_… for the sandbox) for merchant tools — mint both via POST /v2/register or the register tool

tools.name: wavepay_register
tools.description: Register a merchant account — returns merchantId, a live mk_live_… key and a mk_test_… test key on the free tier. Works unsigned.

tools.name: wavepay_providers
tools.description: List the payment rails this deployment has enabled right now.

tools.name: wavepay_pricing
tools.description: Plans, prices and promotions for a product id.

tools.name: wavepay_checkout
tools.description: Create a hosted checkout (or a wallet push with a phone and method) and get the buyer URL or next step.

tools.name: wavepay_checkout_status
tools.description: Poll a checkout's settlement status by reference.

tools.name: wavepay_features
tools.description: Which flagged capabilities (refunds, recurring, bnpl, card_tokens, paypal_billing, disputes) are on for live money; test keys can use all.

tools.name: wavepay_subscribe
tools.description: Open a subscription: automatic (saved card, PayPal) or invoice_and_remind (every wallet). Needs a merchant key.

tools.name: wavepay_bnpl
tools.description: Buy now, pay later on a card: deposit now, instalments until the total is paid; prepaid and virtual cards refused.

tools.name: wavepay_refund
tools.description: Refund a settled PayPal or test payment; Paynow payments are refused with REFUND_UNSUPPORTED.

tools.name: wavepay_test_billing_run
tools.description: Test key only: run the billing engine as if advanceDays had passed.

tools.name: wavepay_catalog
tools.description: Everything the caller's merchant key can sell — sites, plans, live prices.
